name: Simple Icons
summary: 3,400+ free brand SVG icons with a CDN, npm/PHP packages and an icon font, licensed CC0.
description: Over 3,400 SVG icons for popular brands, downloadable one by one from the site or served from a CDN that supports icon colors and dark mode. Packages exist for Node with TypeScript types, PHP and a font distribution, plus third-party extensions for Figma, Blender, Raycast, Stream Deck, Webflow and more. Released under CC0 1.0.
contains: per-icon SVG download from the site
CDN service with color and dark-mode parameters
npm package with TypeScript types and a PHP package
third-party extensions: Figma plugin, Blender add-on, Raycast, Stream Deck, Webflow app
